intro: Every built-in slash command available in Claude Code. Type / in the prompt to autocomplete.

items.desc: Show all available slash commands and shortcuts
Clear conversation history — starts fresh while keeping project context
Compress conversation history to free up context space for long sessions
Show current model, token usage, and session info
Full multi-layer code review of the current branch vs main
Security-focused audit of all changed code on the current branch
Generate a CLAUDE.md for the current project with detected conventions
Open the interactive settings menu (model, theme, permissions)
Switch the active model for the current session
Switch between light, dark, and system themes
List all active MCP servers and their available tools
View and edit the current allow/deny permission rules

sections.title: Context Loading
sections.description: Prefix with # to load files or folders into context before your message.

items.desc: Load a specific file into context
Load all files in a folder into context
Run a shell command and pipe the output into the conversation

items.title: Load context first
items.body: Type #src/lib/auth.ts before your request so Claude reads the file immediately rather than spending a tool call discovering it.

items.title: Chain commands
items.body: Run /review, read the output, then say 'implement the must-fix items' — Claude carries the context forward.

items.title: Custom commands
items.body: Create .claude/commands/deploy.md to define a /deploy command with your team's deploy checklist.
